scope: Live B-rep builders and serialized STL surfaces, separate nominal seated and relaxed printable display covers, fixed donor, dimensional display and tube models; named wall witnesses and sampled sections. No global minimum-wall certification.

display_assembly.sequence: load the display into the opened cover, lift and slide the cartridge from the outlet, then seat it normally
display_assembly.scope: Rigid fit references and independent wing-clearance demand; no elastic deformation or force prediction.

display_under_pcb_reference.scope: Conservative component envelopes from the vendor STEP, with PCB-mounted components lowered by the caliper PCB-height correction; feet preserve their measured datum. Actual component and tube tolerances remain a bench check.

mesh:shell_base.scope: live B-rep tessellated, serialized as STL and loaded again; not a slicer result

mesh:shell_tip.scope: live B-rep tessellated, serialized as STL and loaded again; not a slicer result

mesh:above_counter_plate.scope: live B-rep tessellated, serialized as STL and loaded again; not a slicer result

mesh:display_cover_relaxed_print.scope: live B-rep tessellated, serialized as STL and loaded again; not a slicer result

mesh:lower-outer-loft-accuracy.selection: abs(X)>10 mm and 2<Z<63 mm; outside the lever cut
mesh:lower-outer-loft-accuracy.method: analytic B-rep BSpline surface values on each exact UV rectangle, measured to triangles loaded from the actual serialized STL in bounded nearest-point batches
mesh:lower-outer-loft-accuracy.scope: sampled surface-to-mesh error on the broad lower outer loft; the source file is identified by SHA, and current exporter settings do not establish the provenance of an optional comparison file. Not a two-sided Hausdorff bound or a physical print-surface measurement

route:flavor-tube-radius.method: 401 native derivatives per curved production centerline edge, including spline transitions

drain:continuous-r25-tube.scope: Native CAD curvature, neoFlo nominal 2.5 mm bore and R25 manufacturer specification; no vent performance qualification.

drain:separate-open-outlet.beverage_pattern: two symmetric 1/4-inch flavor tubes above the 3/8-inch soda tube

stock:under-counter-profile.method: All native DXF line endpoints and arc centers/radii/angles match the fixed purchased profile; normalized entity order and full-turn angles.

motion:stock-under-counter-plate-slide.method: The purchased DXF profile is extruded through the union of all steel positions for the 19–38 mm routing envelope. Native member intersections through that complete depth range are contained in circular or rectangular bounds. Exact continuous +X sweeps of those bounds clear this conservative steel envelope for the entire 60 mm installation travel at every intermediate slab thickness.
motion:stock-under-counter-plate-slide.scope: Tube/cable clearance and plate slide within the routing envelope. This does not establish maximum clampable countertop thickness or donor thread engagement. Physical tolerances, cut-edge finish, hand access and installation force require the purchased plate and completed faucet.

clearance:display-body-shell_base.scope: Exact interference only; no minimum-distance measurement or positive clearance claim

clearance:display-body-shell_tip.scope: Exact interference only; no minimum-distance measurement or positive clearance claim

clearance:display-body-display_cover.scope: Exact interference only; no minimum-distance measurement or positive clearance claim

clearance:display-screen-shell_tip.scope: Exact interference only; no minimum-distance measurement or positive clearance claim

clearance:display-screen-display_cover.scope: Exact interference only; no minimum-distance measurement or positive clearance claim

section:neck.method: 72 radial B-rep material chords in one section; last material interval

section:socket.method: 72 radial B-rep material chords in one section; last material interval

section:plug.method: 72 radial B-rep material chords in one section; last material interval

motion:neck-joint.method: tip rotated about the arc axis from closed to plug-clear

wall:base-insert-1.method: complete 2 mm radial witness around the real brass OD over its installed length

wall:base-screw-seat-1.method: eight vertical B-rep chords through the bearing annulus

wall:base-insert-2.method: complete 2 mm radial witness around the real brass OD over its installed length

wall:base-insert-3.method: complete 2 mm radial witness around the real brass OD over its installed length

wall:base-screw-seat-3.method: eight vertical B-rep chords through the bearing annulus

wall:base-pedestal-socket-2.method: complete radial witness around the socket throughout the pedestal engagement

wall:base-pedestal-socket-3.method: complete radial witness around the socket throughout the pedestal engagement

section:lower-closed-body.method: 72 exact radial B-rep chords from the shank axis at each of eight heights
section:lower-closed-body.scope: closed body below the lever opening; radial chords are not global normal thickness

wall:loft-to-donor-rectangle.method: exact minimum distance from the loft's curved side faces to the complete cavity solid
wall:loft-to-donor-rectangle.scope: outer loft only; access-cut and fastener boundaries are checked separately

wall:loft-to-donor-arches.method: exact minimum distance from the loft's curved side faces to the complete cavity solid
wall:loft-to-donor-arches.scope: outer loft only; access-cut and fastener boundaries are checked separately

wall:loft-to-soda-passage.method: exact minimum distance from the loft's curved side faces to the complete cavity solid
wall:loft-to-soda-passage.scope: outer loft only; access-cut and fastener boundaries are checked separately

wall:loft-to-flavor-transition.method: exact minimum distance from the loft's curved side faces to the complete cavity solid
wall:loft-to-flavor-transition.scope: outer loft only; access-cut and fastener boundaries are checked separately

wall:loft-to-signal-transition.method: exact minimum distance from the loft's curved side faces to the complete cavity solid
wall:loft-to-signal-transition.scope: outer loft only; access-cut and fastener boundaries are checked separately

wall:loft-to-lower-signal-lane.method: exact minimum distance from the loft's curved side faces to the complete cavity solid
wall:loft-to-lower-signal-lane.scope: outer loft only; access-cut and fastener boundaries are checked separately

wall:loft-to-vertical-neck.method: exact minimum distance from the loft's curved side faces to the complete cavity solid
wall:loft-to-vertical-neck.scope: outer loft only; access-cut and fastener boundaries are checked separately

wall:lever-to-flavor-transition.method: exact minimum separation between the swept lever clearance and flavor-passage cutters
wall:lever-to-flavor-transition.scope: the rear lever web; intersections with the donor outlet cavity are intentional

wall:lever-cheek.method: complete outward extrusion of each donor-arch cavity outer face into the finished base
wall:lever-cheek.scope: the two outer cheeks over the complete donor-arch footprint

clearance:lever-overhead-profile.method: independently reconstructed circular overhead volume, clipped to the lever opening and above the rest-lever top, intersected with the complete printed base
clearance:lever-overhead-profile.scope: keeps the full overhead relief for the rising rear arm; it is not a measured metal-arm shape or proof of the harvested lever's complete travel

clearance:lever-front-opening.method: independent three-point-arc XY opening profile extruded over its complete height, exact material intersection, the selected point's gap, and any surviving downward insertion-ceiling face area
clearance:lever-front-opening.scope: the entire central span forward of the rounded cap; the circular aft relief and complete donor cheeks have separate readings

wall:lever-front-cap-rim.method: complete radial arch annulus across an equally wide inward band following the rounded front cap, over the full opening width
wall:lever-front-cap-rim.scope: material inside the retained cap at the open rim; not a global minimum-wall certificate

wall:lever-roof-bridge.method: complete 2 mm vertical strip above two wall-widths of the independently reconstructed circular lever roof, clipped to the retained rounded cap and ending one wall-width forward of the water bore
wall:lever-roof-bridge.scope: the bridge from the lever roof into the neck; not every exterior opening edge

section:lever-roof-continuity.method: nine exact vertical B-rep chords from the circular roof at each Y station through two wall-widths of roof and neck
section:lever-roof-continuity.scope: no separated upper slit in the roof-to-neck bridge; exterior rays may end at the show surface

clearance:lower-passage-join.method: three exact point-to-solid gaps and a complete empty-volume witness through the flavor/cable opening handoff
clearance:lower-passage-join.scope: named lower-passage corner and loft handoff; not a global small-feature scan

clearance:display-soda.scope: fixed nominal tube and corrected vendor-component envelopes; no printed central floor

clearance:display-flavor-a.scope: fixed nominal tube and corrected vendor-component envelopes; no printed central floor

clearance:display-flavor-b.scope: fixed nominal tube and corrected vendor-component envelopes; no printed central floor

placement:display-tube-budget.scope: nominal placement only; the tube fit trial checks actual tube motion, component tolerances and contact

wall:cover-lip--1.method: complete relieved lip and independent central unchamfered-core witnesses, nine exact full-height interior chords per side, and complete curved-root-to-show-skin separation

bearing:display-lip-flat-lands--1.method: exact line intervals on actual planar lip and groove faces at nine S stations per side; upper lip translated to the groove ceiling before comparing its flat overlap
bearing:display-lip-flat-lands--1.scope: CAD bearing lands after inner corner relief; printed edge shape and support-contact finish require the real parts

wall:retention-groove--1.method: complete 2 mm annular witness behind the actual swept groove, including its rear torus section

wall:retention-shoulder--1.method: complete annular volume between the original cylinder and groove-root sweep over a 2 mm N band above each retaining shoulder
wall:retention-shoulder--1.scope: retained stock following the curved neck; not a 2 mm vertical column at every point of the outer bearing edge

snap:engagement--1.method: actual lip and groove cylinder/torus radii and clipped face extents in the display frame

wall:cover-lip-+1.method: complete relieved lip and independent central unchamfered-core witnesses, nine exact full-height interior chords per side, and complete curved-root-to-show-skin separation

bearing:display-lip-flat-lands-+1.method: exact line intervals on actual planar lip and groove faces at nine S stations per side; upper lip translated to the groove ceiling before comparing its flat overlap
bearing:display-lip-flat-lands-+1.scope: CAD bearing lands after inner corner relief; printed edge shape and support-contact finish require the real parts

wall:retention-groove-+1.method: complete 2 mm annular witness behind the actual swept groove, including its rear torus section

wall:retention-shoulder-+1.method: complete annular volume between the original cylinder and groove-root sweep over a 2 mm N band above each retaining shoulder
wall:retention-shoulder-+1.scope: retained stock following the curved neck; not a 2 mm vertical column at every point of the outer bearing edge

snap:engagement-+1.method: actual lip and groove cylinder/torus radii and clipped face extents in the display frame

seat:display-cover.method: exact common volume at the designed lip-floor contact pose

seat:display-cover-stop.method: six independent interior floor witnesses after 0.01 mm inward travel; the complete 0.02 mm contact common must remain in the actual lips against groove floors or preload roots, before the display or glass

retention:display-snaps.scope: geometric cover-lip capture only; the roof allowance is nominal upward travel, not a zero-rattle or retention-force prediction. PET-GF force, flex distribution and cycling require the complete print trial

motion:display-cover-normal.obstacle_crop_method: exact conservative bounds of both complete covers, expanded by the full independent outward search budget in X, all normal lifts in N, and 0.1 mm on every face; also contains the inward seating probes
motion:display-cover-normal.scope: final normal seating of the preloaded cover/display cartridge after the lifted axial approach; display and glass move with the cover. Nominal contact must stay in the lips and lower skirts, or reach no deeper than the graze depth outside them. Each skirt's rigid outward translation measures clearance demand, not deformation, strain, force, or the loaded equilibrium shape of the joined end bridges

clearance:snap-travel-display.method: complete nominal and relaxed covers at every final seating station, plus both states' actual lower skirts at half and full measured outward travel; the display/glass share the cover's normal translation, while tubes and neck ribbon remain fixed; exact commons or distance, with conservative box separation where available

clearance:snap-travel-glass.method: complete nominal and relaxed covers at every final seating station, plus both states' actual lower skirts at half and full measured outward travel; the display/glass share the cover's normal translation, while tubes and neck ribbon remain fixed; exact commons or distance, with conservative box separation where available

clearance:snap-travel-ribbon-neck.method: complete nominal and relaxed covers at every final seating station, plus both states' actual lower skirts at half and full measured outward travel; the display/glass share the cover's normal translation, while tubes and neck ribbon remain fixed; exact commons or distance, with conservative box separation where available

clearance:snap-travel-soda.method: complete nominal and relaxed covers at every final seating station, plus both states' actual lower skirts at half and full measured outward travel; the display/glass share the cover's normal translation, while tubes and neck ribbon remain fixed; exact commons or distance, with conservative box separation where available

clearance:snap-travel-flavor-a.method: complete nominal and relaxed covers at every final seating station, plus both states' actual lower skirts at half and full measured outward travel; the display/glass share the cover's normal translation, while tubes and neck ribbon remain fixed; exact commons or distance, with conservative box separation where available

clearance:snap-travel-flavor-b.method: complete nominal and relaxed covers at every final seating station, plus both states' actual lower skirts at half and full measured outward travel; the display/glass share the cover's normal translation, while tubes and neck ribbon remain fixed; exact commons or distance, with conservative box separation where available

shape:display-rigid-neck.method: complete swept subsurface witness above the grooves, exact exterior endpoints and continuous material on 60 chords, no material beyond the cylinder and named foot pads, and the complete full-width opening above the feet; complete pad/backing volumes are checked separately

motion:display-loading-into-cover.method: exact complete downward projection of every upward device face within the cover band, after verifying all reference surfaces are parallel vertical extrusions; independent actual free-wing translation and exact common/distance
motion:display-loading-into-cover.scope: factory loading opens the plastic before the PCB enters. Opening demand is geometric; the joined end bridges, force, spring return and display support require the complete print trial. This is not an elastic shape prediction

motion:display-cartridge-axial.method: exact containment of every relevant fixed solid inside a straight cylinder, plus exact clearance of each complete lifted mover from that S-invariant cylinder; proves the entire axial segment rather than sampled poses
motion:display-cartridge-axial.scope: display and glass travel inside the cover from the outlet. The temporary flexible ribbon branch must be fed during factory assembly; its final route is checked separately. Normal seating and plastic opening have separate readings

motion:cartridge-device-complete-normal.method: exact conservative box containing the complete carried display and glass throughout the final normal stroke, against both shell halves
motion:cartridge-device-complete-normal.scope: complete rigid hardware-to-printed-body seating bound; cover spreading and finished tubing/ribbon clearance have separate readings

wall:display-foot-pads.method: complete four support-pad witnesses plus equally deep full-footprint backing blocks directly below them inside the final single-solid tip

wall:display-cosmetic-shroud.method: exact separation of the complete outer loft's curved side faces and inner cover cavity

wall:display-finished-neck-rim.rear_extent_method: exact distance to a transverse plane beyond the conservative box and covering every X/N projection
wall:display-finished-neck-rim.method: exact finished-cover sections at 13 fore/aft stations including the rear closure; inward normal material chords on both sides at five heights above each actual lower edge
wall:display-finished-neck-rim.scope: sampled neck-rim and corner stock after all cuts. Rays leaving the intentional flat lower rim are reported with independent lateral rim stock and an elevated through-wall normal chord; other short chords still fail. Not a global minimum-wall certificate

wall:display-flush-front.method: exact inward +S material chords at five X stations, from each actual lower rim through the crown of the flush front wall

wall:display-rear-rim.method: exact retained outer-skin sections at X0/±3/±6, then inward surface-normal chords 0.01 to 3 mm above the actual rear rim through the crown
wall:display-rear-rim.scope: the rear central cover bridge; axial chords alone do not certify a tilted wall

shape:display-cover-unchanged-bezel.method: exact symmetric difference of the complete nominal and printed solids above the bezel underside

shape:display-cover-relaxed-preload.method: independent actual-solid X chords at three lip stations and three heights per wing, plus exact common volume against the rigid tip
shape:display-cover-relaxed-preload.scope: the relaxed print is intentionally narrower than the nominal seated reference; the joined end bridges are not an invertible elastic map, and installed equilibrium and preload force require the print trial

wall:display-relaxed-lips.method: complete affine lip witnesses inside the printable solid, with six actual material chords projected onto N and eighteen lateral lip sections

wall:display-relaxed-cosmetic-rims.method: actual printable-solid material chords on the affine images of the finished corner and rear-rim sections, using inverse-transpose surface normals
wall:display-relaxed-cosmetic-rims.scope: sampled material after the wing union; not a global thickness or elastic-deformation certificate

wall:display-relaxed-end-bridges.method: actual free-solid front and rear bridge chords at X0/±3, below and above the unchanged-bezel join
wall:display-relaxed-end-bridges.scope: named central-union sections; the bridges' installed bending and any load on the glass remain physical trial observations

wall:display-rear-opening-rim-seated.method: complete outer-to-inner edge distances on every actual rear opening face, with tangent-perpendicular material chords within that plane; outer edges match the source show skin at three points, using the inverse wing preform for the relaxed part
wall:display-rear-opening-rim-seated.scope: the physical opening band, separate from inward show-wall normals; only the connecting flat lower-edge segments are excluded from the inner-boundary set

wall:display-rear-opening-rim-relaxed.method: complete outer-to-inner edge distances on every actual rear opening face, with tangent-perpendicular material chords within that plane; outer edges match the source show skin at three points, using the inverse wing preform for the relaxed part
wall:display-rear-opening-rim-relaxed.scope: the physical opening band, separate from inward show-wall normals; only the connecting flat lower-edge segments are excluded from the inner-boundary set

coverage:display-rear-electronics.method: exact +S surface crossings and solid-classified material intervals behind occupied display/component or branch-ribbon sections, through the nominal assembled tip and cover
coverage:display-rear-electronics.scope: sampled rear line-of-sight closure around the actual hardware; stock and rim thickness have separate readings. This is not a water-seal or all-angle visibility certificate

section:display-cosmetic-bezel.method: normal material chord through the flat bezel next to the screen opening

position:display-flush-front.method: actual forward-facing planar face and exact negative-S halfspace intersection

wall:outlet-signal-closure.method: full-thickness closure witness above the flavor passage and the neck signal cutter at the outlet plane

wall:dispense-face.method: independent analytic full-thickness cylinder at the final circular section, minus the actual final water/flavor bores and their center triangle; voids extend 1 mm beyond both witness ends; valid stock-minus-tip subtraction and actual cavity rear-plane stations, excluding outlet-plane Boolean residues within the recorded distance tolerance

fixture:complete-display-fit-trial.method: complete production head region through the cable branch, and exact complete relaxed printable cover

fixture:production-print-orientations.method: trial print transforms are read from the same production-print part table

mesh:display_trial_housing.scope: live B-rep tessellated, serialized as STL and loaded again; not a slicer result

motion:lever.scope: the repo's dimensional lever envelope, not a measured scan of the donor lever

position:signal-southwest.scope: the unrestrained ribbon ends before solder fan-out in the southwest quadrant viewed from the glass

solid:display-ribbon-envelope.scope: maximum vendor-stated ribbon section; the modeled end stops beside the PCB before factory solder fan-out

fit:signal-lane-section.method: complete maximum rectangular cable section inside the actual capsule lane

wall:neck-signal-lane.method: exact separation of the plug's circular exterior and full signal-lane profile
wall:neck-signal-lane.scope: the uniform profile; the curved neck, lap and port have separate readings

printing.scope: Geometric orientations only; no slice or physical support-removal result.

physical_checks_remaining: Actual harvested lever dimensions, hand approach and full motion in printed parts.
PET-GF print strength, curved-joint fit and retention, and heat-set insert installation.
Support access and contact finish from a production-profile slice and physical print.
Tube feeding, flow, actual tube/display separation, cable routing and splash drainage.
Factory plastic spreading to load the display without forcing its PCB/glass edges, and feeding the temporary flexible ribbon branch during cartridge travel.
PET-GF cover-wall spreading, installed shape and end-bridge bending, seating and pull-off force, lip strength, repeated closure and release in the complete display fit trial.
